name: Ivana Horvat
bio:
Ivana Horvat's journey into motorsport began in the workshops of Zagreb, fueled by a childhood fascination with engines and a relentless pursuit of understanding how things worked. After completing her engineering degree, she started in a small rally team, quickly proving her aptitude for problem-solving and optimization. Her career has been a steady climb through various racing series, from touring cars to open-wheel racing, always seeking new challenges and opportunities for innovation.

As Chief Engineer for Cool Racing, Ivana brings a meticulous and analytical approach to every aspect of the car's performance. She believes in empowering her team through clear communication and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Her focus is on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, combining data-driven insights with a deep understanding of the car's dynamics to unlock its full potential. Ivana is known for her ability to identify and resolve even the most subtle performance bottlenecks, making her a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Ivana apart is her unwavering commitment to perfection and her innate ability to translate complex engineering concepts into practical solutions on the track. She is respected by her peers for her technical expertise and her dedication to achieving excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Ivana has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor, reflecting her dedication to her craft.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every component before a race.
